title: PH60309: Advanced Topics In Field Theory And Gravitation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

External field methods- quantum effective action , calculation of effective
potential , energy interpretation , symmetries of the effective action ;
Operator product expansion- the expansion , renormalization group equations for
coefficient functions , spectral function sum rules , deep inelastic scattering
; Anomalies- pi^0 decay problem , transformation of the measure: the Abelian
anomaly , anomaly free gauge theories ; Two dimensional field theories- the
Sine-Gordon model , other integrable theories ; Introduction to Conformal field
theories ; Large N theories and 1/N expansion. Methods for solving Einstein s
equation , Causal structures , Singularities , Initial value formulation ,
Asymptotic flatness ; Quantum fields in curved space-time ; Quantum Gravity.
